items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: studying the Schillinger system with Tom Timothy

ctx.x: Oh, after her death, yeah. But the girl that sang it was named Chaney Scott. And I did records, you know, with Larry Darnell and Harry Belafonte and Nat King Cole, Billy Daniels, Andy Williams and Charlie Chavers. In fact, I was at the Metropole with Charlie Chavers when the

Metropole was running big.
So now while I was on the staff I decided to go back
to school. And I went to Rhodes School (PHONETIC) and got my
high school diploma. And really I did that because I was
studying the Schillinger system with Tom Timothy and so one
day I walked out and ran into Rodriguez --
